annotations.title: Pre-trade check: clear, caution, avoid or unknown

description: For an agent's risk step before a buy: one decision for a Robinhood Chain 0x contract or a Solana mint, clear | caution | avoid | unknown, with the reasons worst first (level avoid/caution/ok, a code, one sentence each). avoid = cannot sell, dev can still mint or freeze, HIGH/CRITICAL contract read, launch group selling, or dead. unknown = no stored read, never treat it as clear. Stored reads only, free, never spends a scan.
